name: Asakura Karen
source:
The cunning and cute under-classman.
She is famous among the boys for her cuteness, the girls on the other hand are envious and dislike her.
While she doesn't want to make enemies she has no intention of giving up her cuteness act and rather has no problem using her cuteness as a weapon.
